instrument: FERC show cause orders to six RTOs/ISOs on large load integration (June 18, 2026), Dockets EL26-67 (PJM), EL26-68 (SPP), EL26-69 (NYISO), EL26-70 (MISO), EL26-71 (CAISO), EL26-72 (ISO-NE)
summary: FERC issued separate section 206 show cause orders to each RTO/ISO and its transmission owners: within 60 days justify existing tariffs or file changes covering five areas (transmission service study processes, cost shifting and transparency, co-location and behind-the-meter generation, service for flexible large loads, study of generation serving proximate or co-located loads), plus a 30-day informational report on generation adequacy for large loads.

source.citation: PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., 195 FERC ¶ 61,211 (June 18, 2026), Docket EL26-67-000; companion orders 195 FERC ¶¶ 61,212-61,216

notes: Docket-to-item mapping per release links: E-7 EL26-67, E-8 EL26-70, E-9 EL26-68, E-10 EL26-71, E-11 EL26-72, E-12 EL26-69. Read in the PJM order (pp. 1-45 of 114). Abeyance: requests within 45 days; up to 90 days; FERC will look with great disfavor on extensions. Refund effective date: Federal Register publication. Not intended to disrupt existing arrangements; reforms prospective. Study timeline expectation: 60-90 calendar days. Other five orders not read (parallel).
confidence_note: PJM order read in part (directives, definitions, discussion through P ~60). Other RTO orders and responses/abeyance filings not read; whether abeyances were granted not checked.
text: we direct PJM and the Transmission Owners, within 60 days of the date of this order, to either: (1) show cause as to why the Tariff remains just and reasonable
